critique: The four unmistakable deer, built from red, blue, and yellow facets with emphatic black contours, make a joyful high-key herd while the broad white field and turquoise horizontal bands preserve genuine spareness. The animated black “heron” constructions do not read as deer, and the tiny guinea pig is an irrelevant gag; replace both with rectangular deer silhouettes and let the drifting mist and sparse upright grass carry the motion.
